pr_body:
This patch adds additional options to `toMatchSnapshot` method:
- `pixelCount` - acceptable number of pixels that differ to still
  consider images equal, unset by default.
- `pixelRatio` - acceptable percentage of pixels that differ to still
  consider images equal, unset by default.

Fixes #12167, #10219

issue_context.title: [BUG] Visual Regression testing with Playwright test toMatchSnapshot stops on single pixel difference
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- Playwright Version: 1.19
- Operating System: MacOS
- Node.js version: 17.4
- Browser: Chromium


**Code Snippet**

```javascript
    expect(await page.screenshot()).toMatchSnapshot(
      [name, "1-initial-load.png"],
      {
        threshold: 0.2,
      },
    );
```

If more context needed please see https://github.com/ayroblu/collab-notes/tree/7588d30495039806a576b3a85e99db4ffbf894d9

**Describe the bug**

See attached diff 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4915682/154362835-707c2adf-a221-49e6-af8d-2ea0062a712b.png)

Please note the single red dot in the bottom left ontop of the reset button
comments:
@ayroblu we just landed two new options to the `toMatchSnapshot`: `pixelCount` and `pixelRatio`. You can now specify `pixelCount` to some small non-zero value to avoid one-pixel differences fail comparison.

You can give it a try using `npm i @playwright/test@next`
I thought this used pixelmatch under the hood? I was expecting it to support a percentage out of the box
@ayroblu pixelmatch returns the number of different pixels and diff. The rest is up to its embedder
